body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 17:15Z; my second duplicate today). BEFORE filing any TermAl item, run engram search with 2–3 distinct phrasings of the symptom (for example "retries without end", "bounded retry", "re-admission schedule") and check open AND parked items.

Today's misses:
- w-7a86 duplicated w-b37b4125dcb8 (registration);
- w-a61eb0dfbd49 duplicated the older Greg-directed w-ac230a24d0d8 (bounded Engram retries; Greg's 2026-10-11 contract: a 240 s persisted budget from control-admission acceptance, reusing w-cfcf10b68c9b's fields).
The duplicate nearly led a worker to design a conflicting bound (8 attempts) against Greg's contract.

If a near-match exists, note on it, or file a child under it, instead of a new root.
